rules: Clock increments at0x5c854d before this gate.
Ordinary death initialization at0x5c962a..0x5c9630 precedes this gate.
b4>0 and hp>0: decrement b4 and return before dispatch, including expiry-to-zero call.
b4>0 and hp<=0: zero b4 and continue to dispatch.
limits: Negative b4 values are outside the supported API.
